title: what an OARGT receipt charges for
result: the receipts JSON already carries `accounyear`; `oargt recibos` now returns it as `accountingPeriod` (666bc4b). Deluxe's 261243480 (ref 117) is "2026 / 6", the June Aldealab tasa, domiciliada, voluntaria until 20/10/2026. No detail page was needed. A receipt PDF was not built: the "Obtener" carta de pago issues a payment document counted against `numDocIngMaxPermitidos`, and paid receipts expose their justificante as a `GetDocumentServlet?CUD=` link only once generated.
evidence: live `oargt recibos` with the Deluxe certificate lists a period on all eight receipts; `parseReceiptRows.test.ts`.
